nom: Exuviance AGE REVERSE BioActiv Wash Antiaging Face Cleanser

avis.texte: I was given this product as a repkacemnt option for a previous fascial cleanser that the store didn't carry any longer. I am happy with this product so far. Easy to pump and it really does a great job of cleansing my face.
I just cant get over the top getting stuck every use. Its so annoying that im not even sure if I like the product. I guess its not bad.

This is my go to daily cleanser. It literally feels like it just melts the make up off my face. I feel clean, and not dry after washing my face. I usually follow up with the exfoliating toner pads and their moisturizer.

So ive been using clinique for ever. I was told by an Ulta employee that i needed this. Im only 28 my skin is not horrible or have any wrinkles. The first day i washed i did notice a burn and thought maybe itll go alway and my skin will adjust. Nope at first it was nice and glowy and my skin started to look like i had burned it with red blotches. I did try again and did the same thing and even worse. Maybe im just allergic to something in it. Idk but its too pricey to be doing all of that.
I just start using this face wash and I really like it. It cleans and makes my skin fresh.
Love the foaming action. Does not leave my skin feeling stripped or dry and it effectively removes makeup, even without a double cleanse.
I have used the age reverse wash for over a year and absolutely love it! I can definitely see a difference in my skin!
I love how my skin feels every time after ise this product.My skin feels clean and even!Love it!
Been using this product for years! Love it! Would recommend this product

I do not have sensitive skin at all, never had an issue with any product until this one. It gave me a horrible reaction on my lips. I had to get a prescription for antihistamines, a steroid, and medicated Vaseline. I saw other comments stating the same thing happened to them, so something needs to be changed in the in ingredients.

As someone who has ultra-sensitive skin that is also still susceptible to adult acne, I always thought I had to sacrifice that truly clean feeling for a cleanser that didn't strip my skin. I thought my old gentle, cream cleanser was adequate until I tried this one that was included in the introductory set. I wasn't planning on using this at all, as I had eliminated foam cleansers because they always made me feel dry after using, and whatever ingredient was used as the foaming agent always irritated my skin, but I decided to give this one a try. The results have been amazing and exactly what I've been hoping for in a soap free cleanser. I feel like this truly cleanses my skin and removes dirt from my pores that regular cleansers have never done before. This formula is so gentle and doesn't leave me stripped. I really wish I had discovered this cleanser and Exuviance earlier. My skin has never looked more clear and in line with the care I have been putting into it for years. Nothing has compared to this cleanser after a week of use and I think my search for the perfect cleanser has stopped here.
I like this face wash. Very light and pleasant. Not greasy.

I have been using this product with my morning routine for several years now and don't plan to stop anytime soon. The product feels light and airy when using it and doesn't leave a scent or film when rinsed off. I recommend this to anyone that is sensitive to heavy products or fragrances.
Exuviance has changed my belief in high quality skin care products because I've seen such a dramatic improvement. It's amazing and I feel good about my skin for the first time in 20 years!

Difference! Wow! I was looking at my skin this week and thought. What gas changed? I remembered I added this cleanser to my routine! Making a huge difference in my skin after only two weeks. I will add that I use it along with other Exuviance pads to exfoliate the skin as well as the Exuviance night moisturizer!

I love foam cleansers, especially in the morning when you don't have much to wash off. I've been using the Exuviance toner and eye cream and love those as well! This cleanser makes my skin squeaky clean. This is my new favorite line.
I've been using this product for years and I like how it makes my face feel. It seems to clean very well when I wear makeup. I would definitely recommend this product.

avis.titre: Exuviance has been my go to for years!
avis.texte: I like using this at night and the gentle makeup remover in the morning.
Love how it cleanses and removes my makeup. I highly recommend.
I've been using this cleanser for a couple years and like the ease and the way it removes makeup and mascara easily.

I was told about this product by one of the managers at Ulta and decided to try it out. I love that it is foamy and does a great job with cleansing my face. So far it has been doing a great job. However, Not happy that the cashier forgot to place my free gift for the mask in my bag and of course when I realized it and called they couldn't locate it and was no help at all.
Perfect blend, not to strong doesn't dry your face out and leaves it feeling clean
Best face wash ever! Have very sensitive skin and breakout easily, the only anti-aging wash that has actually WORKED! Had my sister try it and she is hooked also.

Best face wash on the market and I have tried many. I have very sensitive skin and this is non-irritating and so refreshing. Thank you Exuviance for all your wonderful products that make my skin beautiful.
I've only used this for about 3 weeks and already see the difference on my face and neck, recommending to some of my friends and family. Very nice face wash

avis.titre: Yes!!! My makeup is removed in half the time of other bra...
avis.texte: My favorite face wash of all time. I really enjoy the bubbling and I have to say it takes makeup off like no other, so I know I'm deaging myself with this product for sure. I barely have to do much to get all my eye makeup off, it's nuts. I have dry sensitive skin and this is perfect. I use it twice a day no problem that has never been a possibility with other cleansers.
Nice cleanser . Tingling does occur which I don't care for. For me, the cream cleanser works better for my sensitive and dry skin.

I'm using it for years. It tingles a bit when using it and leaves my skin smoother. Fantastic wash. Don't use it with electric brushes though because it's too lightweight. I use it every morning on clean skin. Can't live without it.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so clean!
avis.texte: I have tried tons of high-end skincare. This is the BEST cleanser I have ever used. One pump is all it takes to wash my entire face & neck. It is so lightweight & honestly leaves my skin feeling the cleanest it ever has felt. HIGHLY recommend.

avis.titre: Best addition to my fascial routine!
avis.texte: It's a wonderful addition to my anti-aging regime. It's light and not too harsh on my face.
Love the clean scent - I use it am & pm to keep my skin in top form

avis.titre: I have used this facial cleanser for many years!
avis.texte: Removes every trace of eye/face makeup AND gently washes away dead skin cells to leave face smoother.
Great cleanser. Really enjoy the tingly clean feeling after washing my face with this stuff.

avis.titre: Definitely purchase again. Another staple for my facials.
avis.texte: Great product. Purchase it , you will not be sorry. It will be a go to product!
I've been using this cleanser for two years now and I'm glad I decided to give it a try and stuck with it. It has slowly but surely transformed my skin's texture.

Wow! Incredible results. I have always woken up every morning with congested skin around the T zone and some blackheads and this is with nightly application of Retin A! However, shortly after using this face wash, my skin is much clearer in the morning. I'm still on my 1st bottle. No irritation. No drying. I'm almost skeptical but the results are right in front of my nose and I haven't changed anything else in my routine. I can't attest to aging but definitely clearer skin.
I like that this is a good foam. It doesn't leave your face feeling greasy or dry!
Out of all the face washes I have ever used, this is by far my favorite.

avis.titre: Very clean feeling, but had an odd smell
avis.texte: I am really not sure about this product. I have not noticed a difference and the smell is like when you come out of a pool. Right now I only use it in pm as it was advised to me that its very strong. I use a gentle morning cleanser. I am not sure I would buy this again. Jury is still out.
This is a great foaming cleanser. It washes off easily and doesn't dry out my skin. A little bit goes a long way.
burns and dries my skin out hard to say if it really does anything worthy of the price.
It only takes a few seconds to wash off and all makeup is gone. Feels great.

Love this, I have oily combination skin, mostly only in the t-zone but dry on cheeks and forehead. This CLEARED UP all my blemishes, I don't know how many face washes I went through and this only took a couple days to clear my skin up! I'm on my second bottle and still makes my face look great, as a medical esthetician I would recommend this to anyone younger people and older. For younger people it helps with blemishes and aid in future aging, older people, the ingredients in this help new cell turn over, the reason why we age is because our cell turnover slows down as we age.

avis.titre: My skin is so smooth! I love it!
avis.texte: I got this as a free gift with purchase and love it! Definitely buying!
I use this to wash my face when I'm traveling. It's very gentle and effective. It gets all my makeup off.

i started using this product 6 months ago and never go back to any other product. this is amazing. as soon as you start using it you notice the cleaner , softer brighter skin. it is amazing. I bought this as Christmas gift for my family too.
Definitely see improvement with my skin texture and elasticity using this wash. Plus the foam is refreshing, very easy to use, and you don't need much to get a good lather.
I use this wash iat night and then use the cleansing gel to make sure all , Makeup is removed. This is foaming and goes on very easily
I prefer the gentle cleansing wash from exuviance. This is just ok, doesn't really fell like it's doing much for the tone or texture of my skin.

I wanted to try this because it's not just a cleanser, it actually is supposed to gently exfoliate your skin and stimulate cell renewal which is great for textured or aging skin! The packaging kind of looks like one of those foam hand sanitizer pumps that you see in hospitals but, again, I couldn't care less when the product inside is so good! Just like those pumps, this one foams which is nice. I was worried it wouldn't be thick enough to really cleanse or exfoliate but it does a really good job. Also, because it's a foam, it's really easy to wash off so that's a plus if you have a time consuming skincare routine like I do! It smells kind of medicinal but not in a bad way and it's very faint so it shouldn't bother anyone who is sensitive to smells. I used this every morning for about three weeks and I've been loving my results! I can't say for sure if it's entirely this product that can be credited for softening my skin's texture because I've also been using their toner which boasts similar results but either way I'm a big fan! I received the product free from Exuviance. The opinions expressed in this review are my own.

avis.titre: Rivals Rodan & Fields b/c the results are instant!
avis.texte: Works effectively and lasts for months! Only need a 1/2 pump, instead of a full pump, to cleanse your entire face and neck.

I absolutely love this face wash! Noticed a difference in my face immediately after using and my face felt very smooth. I have combination mostly oily skin and this is just what my face needs. Will definitely purchase again and now apart of my daily regimen!

This is probably the first product I've ever left an online review for, that's how awesome I think this face wash is! I have keratosis pilaris which is a skin condition that leaves me with bumps all over my skin (it looks like I have goosebumps 24/7). I asked a woman at Ulta for a recommendation and she didn't even miss a beat before showing me this product. I've noticed a difference in just 3 uses! It does leave my skin a little dry but I just use my go-to moisturizer directly after and it takes care of that! I'll definitely buy this again and look into this brand's other products!
I liked this face wash. My skin felt smooth after using it but I also felt a little dry( I have sensitive skin and allergies).
Wow! I used this for a few days and now look like I have a terrible sunburn, lots of red pimples (rash?), and peeling. The worst reaction I've had to something in awhile. :(
This is a great cleanser. It is a foam and I'm amazed at how it cleanses and removes all traces of makeup.

At first I wasn't impressed with the product - I had received a small sample bottle (travel size). One day, I ran out of my regular brand product and used it again. This time it was morning versus after work with makeup on. That is when I was surprised! It works wonders on a face after the make is removed. I experimented with it since and also noticed; if I put it on damp skin and leave it for about 3-5 minutes before my shower it works like a mini face treatment! Suggest to rediscover this product if it didn't work before. I use something else to remove my long lasting makeup (just as I do with mascara) and use this to truly cleanes and balance the skin. I am Both a Brand and Budget Buyer (what ever product works best for me) and have repurchased the product multiple times and will continue to purchase!

avis.titre: I've been using this for over a year. I love it!
avis.texte: I use this product twice daily. I use it in conjunction with other Exuviance product and other beauty brands.
Love the results I get with this whole product line! Worth the extra $$. I usually catch it on sale or awesome gift with purchase:)
Have used this for several years and it keeps my skin fresh and healthy looking.
I have just turned 50 couple 6 months ago. I have tried so many skin cleanser over the years. This is the first product that I can actually say I see improvement my skin. Love, love!!!
I clean my face twice a day with this product and it leaves my skin so soft.
Bought this for my Mom and she loves it! She can tell that the EXUVIANCE line of skin care products really does help improve her skin!
It leaves my skin feeling amazing but it does not remove makeup without scrubbing your face.

Love this! The foam cleanser goes on very light and I even wondered if it was even working, when I first tried it. Afterwards,my face felt clean like never before! About 20 minutes later my skin did feel sensitive. Since I have sensitive skin, I started slowly with using it every other night and now 2 weeks later I use it twice a day. Wow! My pores are no longer clogged, my skin feels so clean and my skin is no longer sensitive to it. I also use the Age Reverse Total Correct+Sculpt serum in this line. The serum seems to work much better now that my pores are no longer clogged and I am able to use less serum as a result. Yes, it is pricey for a cleanser, but for me a real game changer. I hope I never run out!
I use this to wash my face before bed. Very gentle but gets your face very clean and feeling fresh not tight or dry.

avis.titre: I have been using this product for years.
avis.texte: It's gentle but it cleanses my skin very well. It's great for any skin type.
I use the Exuviance Purifying Gel Cleanser in the evening with my Clarisonic. This is a great wash for the am (not removing any makeup). I have been using for about a year and love it.
This wasn't my idea of a face wash. I like face wash that lathers when I rub it into my skin, but this one was too weak. I returned and it purchased the combo skin type gel cleanser instead.

avis.titre: I would and have bought this product again and again
avis.texte: I fell in love with Exuviance a little over a year ago. Little by little, I've been trying several more of their products. Their products are wonderful for their anti-aging properties and they are wonderful for sensitive skin.

I got this at the recommendation of one of the women that work at Ulta. My skin has been super dry since i moved to the NW. I was looking for a new foundation that would not get cakey but she said i had to start with getting the problem under control. I use this at night before my serum and moisturizer and then in the morning and in a week it has made an amazing difference. My skin looks brighter and the texture is improving!
Don't have to use alot to be effective. Leave skin feeling amazingly smooth and clean without feeling tight or irritated. Removes eye makeup very well.
I really love this. I have sensitive combination skin and this cleans beautifully without over-drying my skin and without leaving it oily either.
I use this every night. You can feel it working. I have sensitive skin and have had no issues.

This was recommended by an Ulta associate. I was looking for a retinol containing cleanser, but the store had none in stock. This is a great alternative. I use it twice daily and my skin looks clean, refreshed, healthy, and my glow is back. This is more expensive than the cleaner is used to use, but the results are more satisfying. I noticed a refreshed, glowing look after the 1st use.
Was recommended by another customer at the store - tried it loved it will recommend it too

avis.titre: I am obsessed with these products.
avis.texte: I discovered Exuviance about 3 months ago and I can't believe the different in my skin. I'm 48 and my skin has tone has evened out and the wrinkles are diminishing.

avis.titre: This has replaced my other face wash to use this one only.
avis.texte: I wash my face, neck, decollete with this product morning and night. It's a hardworking foam wash that removes makeup and can be used with my Clarisonic.

I have used this product now for about 9 months and I love it. I have combination skin and use it every day - at least once/day, and sometimes twice/day. I keeps my skin clear (I tend to breakout), and has a smoothing effect.
This product seems to remove all of my makeup at night without leaving my skin greasy or dry!

I'm a 40-something prescription Retin-A user and received this product as a sample when I was shopping at Ulta recently. I'm middle of the line about this face wash. It sure does remove my makeup and has tighten my pores a bit, but I'm just not sure it's worth the price when most of the product is rinsed down the drain and doesn't stay on my skin.
Wash cleanser to remove makeup and daily wash. Morning and night ageing products as well.

I purchased the Age Reverse Bioactiv Wash by Exuviance replacing the Cleansing Wash by Exuviance I was using. I was a little skeptical, when I first pressed the measured amount into my hand and it was "foam", thin foam. As I began to apply to my face and neck in a circular motion, it was light, and cleaned my skin, unbelievable. I use it in the mornings and eveinings. It is does not dry, irritate or leave a residue. It surprised me, takes only one pump, a puff of foam, circular motion and viola...sparkling clean skin.

avis.titre: Good Product for Aging and Aged Skin
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a year now and I find it to be easy to use and mild enough for my sensitive skin. While I haven't seen any removal of dark spots, it has helped my skin to remain smooth and (with the companion day cream) healthy looking and feeling. This is a plus for me since as a 60 year old women, I choose to not wear make-up. I get compliments constantly.
I do not recommend this to anyone with sensitive skin . My face is completely irritated and my eyelids are red and puffy . It seems to have made my acne worse also .

This produce is amazing! It works well with my clarisonic. Is very cleansing and doesn't leave residue. My face feels amazing and even after a couple of uses, I can tell a difference in the tone and even complexion of my face. I have semi sensitive skin and it doesn't cause any issues (no irritation or break-outs). I will not switch to any other face wash. Ever.
I have found that my skin is looking better after a couple of weeks.

I love the foamy medium of this product. I'm 41 and my skin is starting to show its age, but at the same time anything heavy breaks me out. I tried this product over a year ago and haven't looked back. It's worth every penny!
Easy on the skin yet cleans when, leaves skin feeling clean and soft
Easy to use only takes a few minutes a day. Other products seem to dry my face.

Just a little goes a long way. I used 1/4 of pump in the am & pm. It did what it was supposed to do. My skin did respond well saw a decrease in my nasal labial area and a lightening of age spots. I had to return it after using it only 4 days due to how much it dried my skin out and stung a little when I used it. This may work for oilier less sensitive skin.

I used morning and night. I love how it tingles ever so slightly I feel my face is really clean. It has helped the texture of my skin. My daughter noticed and asked what I was using. It is a little expensive. But it does work so that is nice.

avis.titre: I love all the exurbia cd products!
avis.texte: I am 62, my skin was in ok condition for my age. I wanted to improve the look of lines especially around my lips and mouth. I have been using many of the exuviance products and notice a definite improvement! I'm getting so many compliments on my skin and most people can't believe my age! I love it!
